WITH telescope_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry,
        o.observstation,
        o.atmostransparency,
        o.humidityrate,
        o.windspeedms,
        o.lunardistdeg,
        t.pointaccarc,
        t.equipstatus,
        t.calibrstatus,
        t.coolsysstatus,
        -- AOI calculation
        CAST(o.atmostransparency AS numeric) * (1 - o.humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) as aoi,
        -- LIF calculation  
        (1 - o.lunardistdeg/180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency) as lif,
        -- Equipment problems
        CASE WHEN t.equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 'Equipment:' || t.equipstatus ELSE NULL END as equip_prob,
        CASE WHEN t.calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 'Calibration:' || t.calibrstatus ELSE NULL END as calib_prob,
        CASE WHEN t.coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 'Cooling:' || t.coolsysstatus ELSE NULL END as cool_prob
    FROM telescopes t
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
with_oqf AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- OQF = AOI * (1 - LIF) * (PointAccArc < 2 ? 1 : 2/PointAccArc)
        aoi * (1 - lif) * CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2.0/pointaccarc END as oqf,
        -- Count equipment problems
        (CASE WHEN equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_problems,
        -- Combined equipment problems string
        CONCAT_WS(', ', 
            CASE WHEN equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 'Equipment:' || equipstatus ELSE NULL END,
            CASE WHEN calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 'Calibration:' || calibrstatus ELSE NULL END,
            CASE WHEN coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 'Cooling:' || coolsysstatus ELSE NULL END
        ) as equipment_problems,
        -- OCL determination
        CASE 
            WHEN aoi > 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
            WHEN aoi < 0.5 OR (equipstatus != 'Operational' AND calibrstatus != 'Current') THEN 'Low'
            ELSE 'Medium'
        END as ocl
    FROM telescope_data
)
SELECT 
    observstation,
    ROUND(AVG(oqf), 4) as quality_score,
    equipment_problems,
    SUM(num_problems) as total_issues,
    MAX(ocl) as confidence_level
FROM with_oqf
GROUP BY observstation, equipment_problems
ORDER BY quality_score DESC;

WITH telescope_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t.telescregistry,
        o.observstation,
        CAST(o.atmostransparency AS numeric) * (1 - o.humidityrate/100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) as aoi,
        (1 - o.lunardistdeg/180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency) as lif,
        t.pointaccarc,
        t.equipstatus,
        t.calibrstatus,
        t.coolsysstatus,
        (CASE WHEN t.equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN t.calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN t.coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_problems,
        CONCAT_WS(', ',
            CASE WHEN t.equipstatus != 'Operational' THEN t.equipstatus ELSE NULL END,
            CASE WHEN t.calibrstatus != 'Current' THEN t.calibrstatus ELSE NULL END,
            CASE WHEN t.coolsysstatus != 'Normal' THEN t.coolsysstatus ELSE NULL END
        ) as prob_label
    FROM telescopes t
    JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
with_oqf AS (
    SELECT *,
        aoi * (1 - lif) * CASE WHEN pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2.0/pointaccarc END as oqf,
        CASE 
            WHEN aoi > 0.8 AND equipstatus = 'Operational' AND calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
            WHEN aoi >= 0.5 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END as ocl
    FROM telescope_data
)
SELECT 
    observstation,
    telescregistry,
    ROUND(oqf, 4) as calculated_observation_quality_factor,
    prob_label as equipment_problems,
    num_problems as number_of_issues,
    ocl as observational_confidence_level
FROM with_oqf
ORDER BY oqf DESC;
